description: This Java source file defines the 'Answer' entity class for a persistence layer, including annotations for ORM mapping, ID generation strategy, and JSON serialization behavior. It models an answer associated with a question in a survey or quiz application.

classes.name: Answer
classes.description: Represents an answer entity mapped to the 'answers' table with fields for ID, text, and a link to a question, including ORM and JSON serialization annotations.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the answer.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the answer.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Retrieves the text content of the answer.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Sets the text content of the answer.

methods.name: setQuestion
methods.description: Associates a question with this answer.
